card: This PR enables Boost.MultiIndex invariant checking in two existing CI jobs that already run with safe mode. The flag ensures multi-index container invariants are validated after operations during automated testing, catching container consistency bugs. The MSAN fuzzing job is deliberately excluded and annotated with a comment to avoid hitting CI execution timeouts.
changed_since_previous: No functional changes; rebased or refreshed with unchanged scope.
evidence: Author cites Boost.MultiIndex documentation noting invariant checking performs validation after every container operation, and notes in the PR description and diff that it is omitted from MSAN fuzzing because it would push that job past the 240-minute limit on the Warp runner.
problem: CI jobs test Boost.MultiIndex safe mode (which validates iterator safety and preconditions) but omit invariant checking, missing automated post-operation validation of multi-index container structure and consistency during CI runs.

risk.why: Touches only CI configuration flags and comments; a mistake could only break or time out CI test runs.

summary: Enable Boost.MultiIndex invariant checking (`BOOST_MULTI_INDEX_ENABLE_INVARIANT_CHECKING`) in the two CI test jobs that already run with safe mode enabled. Add an explanatory comment to the MSAN fuzzing job explaining that invariant checking is omitted there to stay under runner time limits.
